title: Every agent clones its vaults in pack mode, never a plain clone
note: The editor, 28 October 2026: a session cloned with a plain sgit clone because its card gave no mode. Brief records/briefs/2026-10-28__brief__how-an-agent-clones-a-vault.md names the mode per agent (--path, --no-checkout then checkout, --pack-store). Each agent: put the mode in your card where you clone, say so in your run record. Closes when every vault-using card names its mode.
